description: Coarse midterm national House vote-to-seat calibration used by model v0.1.
source_note: Seat totals and national House popular-vote shares are drawn from public historical election statistics; the model uses D-minus-R popular-vote margin as the explanatory variable.
limitations: This is a deliberately simple seat-vote calibration, not a district-level historical replay.
Mid-decade redistricting and incumbency/candidate effects are not represented in this regression; the current map prior is intended to absorb some of that information.
